## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Include a screenshot for visible changes using demo data. Explain any checks that do not apply.

## Compatibility

State the effect on existing libraries, saved attempts, installer identity, and offline behavior.

- [ ] Private study material, credentials, and personal information are excluded.
- [ ] Relevant behavior and regression checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog reflect any behavior changes.
- [ ] Storage and release compatibility have been considered, or do not apply.
